camel_example: aliyun amqp-open CreateBinding --region cn-hangzhou --SourceExchange NormalEX --InstanceId 'amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu***' --BindingType 0 --DestinationName DemoQueue --VirtualHost test
description_en: Creates a binding. After a producer sends a message to an exchange, the exchange routes the message to a specified queue or another exchange based on the created bindings and routing rules
description_zh: Producer将消息发送到Exchange，Exchange根据创建的绑定关系以及路由规则选择将消息路由到指定的Queue或其他Exchange中
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open create-binding --instance-id 'amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu***' --virtual-host test --source-exchange NormalEX --destination-name DemoQueue --binding-type 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBinding

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the vhost. The vhost must be created in the console and must be the vhost to which both DestinationName and SourceExchange belong
parameters.help_zh:
Vhost名称。
此Vhost已在控制台创建且是DestinationName和SourceExchange所属的Vhost
parameters.name: virtual_host

parameters.help_en: The name of the source exchange. The exchange must be created in the console
parameters.help_zh: 源Exchange名称，且此Exchange已在控制台创建
parameters.name: source_exchange

parameters.help_en: The name of the binding destination. The destination must be created in the console and belong to the same vhost as SourceExchange, which is specified by VirtualHost
parameters.help_zh:
绑定目标名称。
此绑定目标需已在控制台创建且所属Vhost与SourceExchange所属Vhost一致，即在VirtualHost中
parameters.name: destination_name

parameters.help_en:
The binding key.

If the source exchange is not of the topic type:

    - The binding key can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), periods (.), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@).

    - The binding key must be 1 to 255 characters in length.

If the source exchange is of the topic type:

    - The binding key can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), asterisks (*), periods (.), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@).

    - The binding key cannot start or end with a period (.). If the binding key starts with a number sign (#) or an asterisk (), a period (.) must follow it. If the binding key ends with a number sign (#) or an asterisk (), a period (.) must precede it. If a number sign (#) or an asterisk (*) is in the middle of the binding key, it must be preceded and followed by a period (.).

    - The binding key must be 1 to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
绑定键。

绑定源Exchange为非Topic类型：

    - 只能包含字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@）。

    - 长度限制1~255字符。

绑定源Exchange为Topic类型：

    - 可以包含字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、星号（*）、半角句号（.）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@）。

    - 不能以半角句号（.）开头或结尾。对于井号（#）或星号（*），如果以其开头，则其后需有半角句号（.），如果以其结尾，则其前需有半角句号（.），如果既不是开头也不是结尾，则其前后均需有半角句号（.）。

    - 长度限制1~255字符
parameters.name: binding_key

parameters.help_en:
The type of the binding destination. Valid values:

0: queue

1: exchange
parameters.help_zh:
绑定目标对象的类型。取值：

0：Queue

1：Exchange
parameters.name: binding_type

parameters.help_en:
The key-value pairs of the message header attributes. The message header attributes are concatenated by using one or more key-value pairs. The x-match attribute is required, and other attributes are custom. Valid values of the x-match attribute:

all: This is the default value. All key-value pairs of the message headers must match.

any: At least one key-value pair of the message headers must match.

Separate attributes with semicolons (;) and separate attribute keys and values with colons (:). Example: x-match:all;type:report;format:pdf.
This parameter applies only to headers exchanges and is invalid for other types of exchanges. For other types of exchanges, you can set this parameter to any value
parameters.help_zh:
设置消息头属性键值对信息，消息头属性使用一个或多个键值对拼接而成。x-match属性必须配置，其余属性可自定义。x-match属性取值如下：

all：默认值，所有消息头的键值对必须匹配。

any：至少一对消息头的键值对必须匹配。

属性之间使用半角分号（;）隔开，属性键与值之间使用半角冒号（:）区分。例如x-match:all;type:report;format:pdf
该参数适用于Headers Exchange，对其它类型的Exchange无效。其它类型的Exchange，此处可以填任意值
parameters.name: argument
